text:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — we just flagged a routing/auth issue affecting a slice of EU onboarding tenants (mostly trial and low-touch SMB batches). Errors are causing webhook ingest and initial embedding jobs to fail, delaying first-index availability. Working with eng to confirm root cause. Need comms and renewal-risk triage.

Alex Kim: Ugh. Do we have the list of affected accounts yet? I want to prioritize any renewals or enterprise trials.

Priya Nair: Minimal list ready — sending to CS leads in DM now. Affected cohort ~42 tenants, 6 are in renewal window (>45 days).

Sam Torres: What’s the immediate mitigation? Can we temporarily route to the hosted fallback model for onboarding runs only?

Priya Nair: Eng says temporary host fallback is possible but requires opt-in consent (data routing). We should offer to customers as an opt-in mitigation + provide usage credits while we remediate.

Nadia Patel: For the 6 renewals: suggest "high-touch" outreach + 1:1 enablement session offer, and an SLA credit. We should craft two templates: (A) technical status for developers, (B) business-facing for execs/renewals.

Priya Nair: Agreed. Draft templates below — please iterate quickly. We’ll send technical immediately, business-facing after legal ok on credits.

Priya Nair: ```Technical message (short):
Hi <Name>,
We’re investigating an authentication/routing issue impacting webhook delivery and initial embedding/indexing for a subset of EU onboarding tenants. Symptoms: failed webhook, repeated 502/401 during first-run. Mitigation: we can enable a hosted fallback for your onboarding runs with customer opt-in, and we will apply a credit equal to one week of usage while we restore normal routing.
What we need from you: reply to confirm opt-in for fallback or permission to pause and retry later.
Apologies for the disruption — we’ll share an RCA within 72 hours.
Regards,
<CS rep>```

Priya Nair: ```Business-facing message (short):
Hi <Name>,
I’m reaching out to share we observed an incident affecting first-time index jobs for a small group of EU accounts. We’re prioritizing your onboarding and can offer a tailored remediation: a live enablement session this week, an account credit, and daily status updates until resolved. If you have an upcoming renewal, we’re happy to discuss terms and any concerns.
Best,
<CS Lead>```

Alex Kim: Nice. For the renewals, add: "we will extend trial/credits to cover any lost time" — helps conversion. Also add one-sentence technical note about expected ETA when eng provides one.

Sam Torres: Action items for CS reps: 1) send technical template to all affected immediately, 2) mark renewal-risk accounts and escalate to Nadia for 1:1 outreach, 3) offer hosted fallback opt-in link, 4) schedule enablement slots and record attendance.

Nadia Patel: I'll pair with legal on the credit wording. Also want a short tracking spreadsheet column: "renewal_risk_tier" and "engagement_scheduled" so we can quantify outreach success for CSM leads.

Priya Nair: Cool. Draft opt-in copy for the fallback link and a small consent checkbox: 
`I consent to temporarily route onboarding data to Redwood-hosted inference for remediation (see privacy note).`

IncidentBot: Incident 2026-04-30-EOU-Auth created. Status: investigating. ETA: T+6h for mitigation plan.

Priya Nair: Timeline: plan to send technical messages in next 30 minutes, business-facing to renewals after credit wording confirmed (~T+2h). Daily summary to affected customers at 18:00 CET until RCA posted.

Alex Kim: I’ll compile the affected list and flag the 6 renewals now.

Sam Torres: I’ll draft the hosted-fallback instructions (one-click opt-in flow + rollback note).

Nadia Patel: I’ll own outreach for renewals and schedule the enablement sessions — will post calendar invites to the thread when ready.

Priya Nair: Thanks all. Tagging @oncall-eng once eng has a mitigation patch. Will update thread when messages go live.

Alex Kim: Sent technical messages to cohort at 2026-04-30T10:35Z. Will paste sample send log after follow-up. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Update: legal approved credit language at 2026-04-30T11:10Z. Business-facing messages queued for renewals.

Sam Torres: Hosted fallback opt-in link created: https://deployments.redwood.ai/fallback-optin/abcd — contains consent checkbox + simple rollback instructions.

Priya Nair: Final: we've scheduled 4 enablement sessions and applied provisional credits to affected renewal accounts. Last update timestamp: 1713500123. Will circulate RCA draft when eng posts root cause.

Nadia Patel: Great work — will follow up with post-outreach feedback survey link so we can capture NPS/qualitative notes. :sparkles:
